newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banorte says agrees to buy insurer.
newsitem.headline: Banorte says agrees to buy insurer.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Banorte said on Tuesday it agreed with its stockholders to acquire insurer Aseguradora Obrera, pending approval.

"There is an agreement in principle...it is in the works. There is already an agreement with the stockholders," Banorte director general Francisco Gonzalez told reporters. He declined to say at what cost it would acquire the insurer.
Gonzalez said the intention to purchase the insurer rounds out the company's recent pension fund creation.
"With this adquisition, the financial group completes the three entities with which it will be able to secure long-term savings," Gonzalez said.
He added that the bank will find out this month if it is the top contender for the sale of Banpais bank. If Banorte acquires the bank, it will boost its branches to 450 from a current 246.
Banorte recently bought Banco del Centro as part of a program to increase its presence in the north of Mexico.
